Comparison brief: Tidewell APM vs Solstice APM
evidence_dose=0 (positive ⇒ more points favour Tidewell APM)

- p1: trace ingest lag (s): Tidewell APM=1.8 ← better | Solstice APM=3.4
- p2: span retention (days): Tidewell APM=30  | Solstice APM=45 ← better
- p3: agent CPU overhead (%): Tidewell APM=1.9 ← better | Solstice APM=3.1
- p4: per-host monthly cost ($): Tidewell APM=29  | Solstice APM=22 ← better
- p5: sampling fidelity at 1% (recall): Tidewell APM=0.94 ← better | Solstice APM=0.88
- p6: alert evaluation delay (s): Tidewell APM=20  | Solstice APM=12 ← better
- p7: supported runtimes (count): Tidewell APM=24 ← better | Solstice APM=17
- p8: dashboard p95 load (ms): Tidewell APM=910  | Solstice APM=640 ← better

Tally: Tidewell APM better on 4/8; Solstice APM better on 4/8.
